title: The normalized lifted coefficient quotient is a regular principal quotient
statement: For the coefficient DVR O_E, uniformizer π, and n≥0, let R=ULift O_E and A=ULift(O_E/(π^(n+1))). The actual pointReductionQuotient map f:R→A is onto; f(x)=0 iff x=t*y for some y, where t=(up π)^(n+1); and multiplication by t is injective on R.

proof.text: The coefficient uniformizer is nonzero by the DVR theorem. Cancel its positive power in O_E, a subring of E, and transport through ULift to get injectivity.

proof.text: Lift a quotient representative to obtain surjectivity. Rewrite quotient-zero as membership in the ideal (π)^(n+1)=(π^(n+1)), then as divisibility. Transport the witness through ULift.

theorem pointReductionQuotient_properties (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (fun x : ULift.{u + 1, u} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E) ↦
      ULift.up (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E) ^ (n + 1) * x) ∧
    Function.Surjective (pointReductionQuotient l E n) ∧
    ∀ x : ULift.{u + 1, u} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E),
      pointReductionQuotient l E n x = 0 ↔ ∃ y,
        ULift.up (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E) ^ (n + 1) * y = x
